# pai-orbit brand assets

pai-orbit is part of the **pai** family of AI software by Pratham Software (PSI).

**Idea:** in "pai", the dot of the "i" escapes and becomes an orange planet on an orbit ring.
The product name "orbit" sits outside the ring, to the right. The icon drops the name.

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `pai-orbit-logo-light.svg` | Logo on light backgrounds |
| `pai-orbit-logo-dark.svg` | Logo on dark backgrounds |
| `pai-orbit-logo.svg` | Logo in `currentColor` (inline SVG that follows the text colour) |
| `pai-orbit-icon.svg` | Favicon, avatar, social card (no name) |

Colours: ink `#111110` / `#f2f1ed`, muted "orbit" `#6f6d67` / `#a9a79f`, planet `#eb6834`.

All text is converted to vector paths, so the files don't depend on fonts.

> **Stand-in lettering.** "pai" is drawn with the open-source Caveat font (OFL) and "orbit" with
> Space Grotesk (OFL) until the official pai lettering is available. When it is, redraw the
> wordmark from the official file, keeping the escaped-dot planet and the orbit ring.
